title: onobrychis humilis
intro: Onobrychis humilis, commonly known as the dwarf bird's foot trefoil, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Onobrychis humilis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, diabetes, and neurodegenerative disorders.
